verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a first-party Experimentation product that measures metrics such as page views, clicks, load time and infrastructure cost, including warehouse-native data from sources like Snowflake. It offers several metric types and uses Bayesian statistics that declare a winning variation, or highlight the leading one when data is insufficient. A/B tests and experiments are also listed on the pricing page. missing for 10: explicit documentation that experiments support multivariate (more than two variation) designs, since evidence only shows multivariate flags; independent or hands-on corroboration of the experimentation workflow and winner reporting.
